analogy.rationale: PKM activators modulate glycolytic flux, but the transcriptional consequences in these cell lines are modest and largely metabolic, overlapping weakly with insulin sensitizers and other metabolic/growth-pathway modulators; no reference class shares a strong downstream transcriptional program.
